Each v5 body pins exact prior comments/hashes and superseded statements. Consumer pins the full common v5 hash. Earlier A–E/binding decisions outrank author text; unaffected mechanisms stay required.

## Concrete review target

F1 is addressed by proposed SealedGitDomain: pinned Git 2.43.0/files/SHA-1 build/runtime, immutable effective config/attributes/ENV, closed command/child graph, fixed production hook slots, exact parent-owned operation/ref/phase admission, and private external preparation without callback authority. A genuine client/script plus inherited descriptor and live Git ancestry is explicitly insufficient outside the sealed domain. No arbitrary helper is admitted inside it. This is a NEW mechanism for independent judgment, not a claimed baseline feature or a binding-detail relabeling.

Filters, message editors, formatter/restaging and skill-sync generation remain real private preparation with exact effects sealed; actual hook occurrences remain required evidence. Signing, custom merge drivers, executable custom hook configuration and unknown runtime profiles have concrete before-setup refusals. Required ordinary unsigned commit, builtin rebase/conflict/continuation, known dirty auto-stash, clean exact-OID submodules, installed production-hook behavior and generic code/team/store positives must remain supported. If a required positive needs a excluded variant or an additional internal child, the exact adapter/command remains a blocker; no broad refusal grants acceptance.

Refinements 1–5 are explicit in the common body and incorporated by the consumer: version/ref protocol; production effects and FINAL message/store snapshot; immutable COMMIT versus later observations/final receipt; inclusive pump deadline and nonchild OS-handle/containment quiescence; substrate independence. Consumer explicitly preserves refinement 6: complete forge pagination, authoritative empty versus unavailable/incomplete association, and local reopen/hold/open-episode revalidation at begin and START/record/ship. Accepted-default B/C/O/W design is preserved, not redesigned.

Proposed `git_callback_descendant_cannot_forge_observation` includes real commit/rebase/P4/recovery with production hooks, fake HOME/vendor/forge, genuine client/shell exec from a configured helper, copied/inherited live capability, correct repo/live Git ancestry, forged prepared/committed/rewrite input, withheld real callbacks, changed config, partial IO and publisher death. Inside-domain helper configuration must be excluded/refused before setup; helper execution there disproves the boundary. Paired genuine callbacks and ordinary preparation positives remain mandatory. Existing lock/cross-repo/history/peer/no-residue/bootstrap/crash/accepted-default witnesses remain required. All are proposed and unexecuted.

## Preserved state and limits

Exact canonical before/after comparisons verified unchanged descriptions, status/stored status, exposed history, relationships, queue membership, deferred/blocker fields and every prior comment. Only one requested v5 addition was appended per spec. Both statuses remain Approved; that is not independent sketch signoff. Writes succeeded normally; no application gate refusal or bypass occurred. Worker sandbox authorization supplied no application authority.

Only the three requested new handoff files, canonical additions and advisor notification belong to this turn. No source implementation, builds, tests, status/queue/relationship/grant/hold changes, dispatch, cleanup, commit/push, merge or live experiments. Hash/readback verification is document verification, not acceptance-test execution. The new mechanism and compatibility limits await a different advisor.
